_comment: The screens the Flutter app mirrors (docs/adr/0008). A pull request that changes a file matched by `v2` must link the cheapest-go-mobile pull request that updates `flutter`, or carry the `mobile-parity-exempt` label. Checked by scripts/mirrored-screens.ts.
Add a screen in the slice that brings it to parity, never before: an entry here blocks web pull requests until mobile follows.

Patterns are paths from the repository root. `*` matches within one folder and `**` across folders; everything else is literal, so [locale] and (dashboard) mean exactly those folders. End a folder with /**.
